items.title: NVIDIA Stock Can Fall By A Third Or Rise By Half And Still Be Normal
items.summary: The band the options market has drawn around this stock is barely wider than the swings it already delivers, which makes that width a baseline rather than a passing scare.

items.title: The AI Opportunity Qualcomm Investors May Be Underestimating
items.summary: Wall Street treats Qualcomm like a handset company in slow decline, but a closer look at its data center roadmap and two confirmed hyperscaler wins suggests investors are pricing in the wrong business entirely.

items.title: Nvidia’s Trillion-Dollar Chip Market Has Friends and Foes Closing In
items.summary: The chipmaker remains dominant for now, but an onslaught of companies is encroaching on its territory.

items.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Hands Sergio Buniac A Bigger Role In Mobile And AI
items.summary: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS: QCOM) appointed Sergio Buniac as executive vice president and group general manager of Mobile, Compute and Personal AI. Buniac brings more than three decades of experience from Motorola to the new role. The position covers Qualcomm's mobile, computing and personal AI product areas. QUALCOMM is far from the only company linked to the build out of AI devices and infrastructure, so it can be useful to compare this leadership shift with peers exposed to the same theme...

items.title: The Best Semiconductor Stock to Buy Isn't AMD or Qualcomm: It's Nvidia, and Our Data Proves It
items.summary: Nvidia is leagues ahead of its rivals in the lucrative AI chip market.

items.title: The $116 Billion That NVDA Quietly Paid Its Owners
items.summary: The chipmaker’s stock performance gets all the attention, but behind the scenes it runs one of the largest cash-return machines on the market.

items.title: The Hidden Tax Cost of JEPI’s Monthly Income Machine
items.summary: JEPI's 8% monthly yield looks like an obvious win over SCHD's modest payout, but the IRS treats those two income streams in ways that can quietly flip the comparison depending on where you hold them.

items.title: Micron Technology Stock Has Become A Bet On Memory Prices
items.summary: Micron's record revenue arrived on shipments that barely grew, which leaves the price of memory carrying the entire case.
